summary: Iteration 3 tested all new Domus features: Terminus views + SensorDetail modal + full sensor names, Cameras (privacy/NV/PTZ/snapshot/simulate-motion/toggles), Video doorbells + intercom ring/unlock cycle, Sol Invictus Media tab (MediaPanel, MediaDetail, TTS, notify, AnnouncePanel), Home Assistant connector against local fake_ha.py (connect, import, states, live WS sync HA→Domus, service call Domus→HA, disable, clear token, settings token masking), Backups (list/create/download/restore round-trip/path traversal blocked/import invalid JSON), Problems endpoint shape, Settings dialog tabs (Casa/HA/Backup/Problemi). Backend: 34/34 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_domus_v3.py (parallel + serial). Frontend: Terminus shows full names (no ellipsis), 3 view tabs including 2 seeded (Perimetro Esterno, Interno Notte), SensorDetail modal exposes all required testids, CameraDetail exposes privacy/NV auto|on|off/motion-detection/siren/led/flip/record/snapshot/simulate-motion/PTZ pad/name/room/delete, ViewEditor opens with 19 members and layout toggles, IntercomWidget shows 3 cards (citofono + Blink doorbell + 1 HA). Sol Invictus Media tab renders MediaPanel with stats (Schermi 3, Altoparlanti 4 including HA-imported), 7 media cards, MediaDetail with seek/message/send-tts/send-notify/class chips, AnnouncePanel with tts-all/tts-none/send. Header ha-mode-pill correctly shows 'HA live' when connected. Settings dialog exposes all 4 tabs and every specified testid on HA/Backup/Problemi. HA→Domus live sync verified (led_salotto on within <15s via WebSocket) and Domus→HA service call verified (light.turn_on captured in /_test/calls). Backup restore round-trip verified (rename view, backup, rename again, restore reverts to original). Mobile 390px Terminus has no horizontal overflow; Sol Invictus Media tab HAS overflow caused by sol-tabs bar (486px vs 390 viewport).

ui_bugs.issue: sol-tabs (Dispositivi/Clima/Consumi/Media) is 486px wide and overflows the 390px mobile viewport, causing horizontal scroll. Last tab ('Media') is partially clipped on the right edge. Should wrap or be horizontally scrollable/collapsible on mobile.
'media-has-screen' testid is not rendered for TV-class devices (only speakers). Spec lists it as part of MediaDetail; either always render (disabled for TV) or update the spec. Not blocking.

issues: sol-tabs bar exceeds viewport width at 390px (see ui_bug).

action_items: Fix mobile overflow on Sol Invictus tab bar (sol-tabs) — make it flex-wrap or overflow-x-auto scroll-snap at <=430px; currently pushes body to 502px wide on iPhone SE.
Consider always rendering 'media-has-screen' testid (disabled for TVs) so tests can rely on it uniformly, or amend spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/cameras/{id}/ptz accepts direction OR preset; body PTZBody validation is fine but 400 message could be Italian to match app locale ('direzione o preset richiesti').

server.py /api/backups/{name}/download uses FileResponse without safe_name check (safe_name is only called on delete/restore paths). Verified path traversal returns 400/404 via delete route, but same defence should be applied to the download route for consistency.
server.py media_apply raises HTTPException inside a helper; consider surfacing a shared handler so tests can rely on stable 400 shape.
public_settings correctly masks ha_token to '' and exposes ha_token_set boolean — confirmed no token leaks in /api/settings, /api/app-data or /api/ha/config response.

media stats on the frontend count ALL screens (including Nest/Echo Show) as 'Schermi' — spec said media-stat-tv=2 but count is 3 because Nest Hub is included. Consider clarifying label ('Schermi' includes any screen-capable device).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all specified testids/flows verified; 1 mobile overflow bug on sol-tabs, 1 missing testid on TV MediaDetail)

test_credentials: None (no auth). Fake HA at http://127.0.0.1:8123 token demo-token.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_View, temp backups (domus-*-TESTv3.json, domus-*-RESTOREtest.json) and clean them up. HA connect/import may add HA-linked entities and a 'Studio' room (persisted). Final cleanup disables HA (ha_enabled=false) and resets backup_dir to /var/lib/domus/backups.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite v3 covers all new endpoints (/api/views CRUD, /api/cameras/{id}/ptz+simulate-motion, /api/media/{id}/command + tts + notify, /api/ha/config+import+states+status live sync, /api/backups full lifecycle, /api/problems, intercom+doorbell ring/answer). To retest HA flows: start fake HA (`cd /app/backend && nohup python3 tests/fake_ha.py > /tmp/fake_ha.log 2>&1 &`) then run pytest with `-o addopts=''` (project pytest.ini enables xdist parallel scope which fails HA disable/enable test ordering when unrelated tests race). All required frontend data-testids are wired and match spec (sensor-detail/-state-label/-battery/-bypass/-simulate/-name-input/-kind-*/-room/-view-*/-icon-btn/-delete, camera-detail/-privacy/-nv-{auto,on,off}/-motion-detection/-siren/-led/-flip/-record/-snapshot/-simulate-motion/-name-input/-room/-delete, ptz-pad/-preset-*, intercom-card-*/-simulate-ring-*/-unlock-*/-hangup-*/-lock-*/-mute-*/-preview-*/-settings-*, media-panel/-stat-tv/-stat-speakers/-power-*/-play-*/-next-*/-prev-*/-volume-*/-mute/-app-*-*/-open-*, media-detail/-seek/-message/-send-tts/-send-notify/-class-tv/-class-speaker (media-has-screen only on speakers), announce-panel/-message/-send-tts/-send-notify/tts-all/tts-none, tts-target-*/notify-target-*, ha-mode-pill, settings-tabs (settings-tab-general/ha/backup/problems), ha-settings/-status-card/-status-label/-url-input/-token-input/-connect-btn/-check-btn/-import-btn/-states-btn/-disable-btn/-clear-token-btn/-tts-input, backup-settings/-status/-dir-input/-dir-save/-auto-{off,hourly,daily,weekly}/-retention-input/-label-input/-create-btn/-list, problems-section/-summary/-count/offline-simulation-toggle/show-online-toggle, open-view-editor-btn, view-editor/-name/-save/-layout-grid/-layout-compact/-member-*, view-tab-all/view-tab-{id}). The only real UI bug is mobile overflow on sol-tabs.
rca of the issue: Mobile overflow on Sol Invictus: `sol-tabs` container uses a fixed flex-row layout with 4 chip buttons (Dispositivi, Clima, Consumi, Media) plus icons and padding, totalling ~486px. On viewports <=430px, this overflows and pushes body scrollWidth to 502px causing the whole page to scroll horizontally. Fix: add `overflow-x-auto scroll-smooth snap-x` on the tabs container OR switch to `flex-wrap` OR conditionally hide labels below md breakpoint. Root cause identified via runtime bounding-rect scan; the decorative sun ellipse/rays (svg/ellipse/rect/fx-rays) also extend past the viewport but are inside overflow-hidden hero card so they don't contribute to the body scroll width. Reproduction: set viewport 390x844, load /, click [data-testid='tab-media'], observe document.body.scrollWidth === 502.
